major_issues.title: Answer-shape outcome uses a condition-dependent target
major_issues.evidence: F00/F10 clear inferred_shape; the validator defaults missing expected column count to 1, whereas F01/F11 use question-derived counts. Reviewer common-target rescore changed hint main effects from 0.4944/0.4528 to 0.4083/0.3556 for Qwen/Granite.
major_issues.required_action: Recompute the endpoint with one frozen target per question across all cells, independently audit it, regenerate artifacts and claims, and define whether the metric checks columns only or also granularity/order.
major_issues.verification: All four cells use identical per-question target metadata; direct rescore and canonical tables agree for 1440 rows.

major_issues.title: Schema-scope factor is a bundled context intervention
major_issues.evidence: Full cells receive full schema plus global value dictionary; compact cells receive selected schema, matched values, and extra question-derived normalization hints.
major_issues.required_action: Relabel as a context-package factor and revise interpretations, or rerun a controlled schema-only factor with invariant value/normalization context.
major_issues.verification: A factor-invariance audit lists every prompt field and shows that only the declared intervention fields differ.

major_issues.title: Answer-shape hint is a corpus-tailored composite intervention
major_issues.evidence: Rules include exact projections, COUNT/AVG/SUM, GROUP BY/HAVING, ORDER BY and LIMIT; inferred column count matches all 180 exposed test metadata records.
major_issues.required_action: Disclose the frozen rules and development history, show representative prompts, and rename the factor to structural/SQL-operation hints unless a pure-shape intervention is rerun.
major_issues.verification: Methods and supplement permit independent reconstruction without reading gold metadata; claims are scoped to the exposed corpus.

major_issues.title: Applied validation is limited to a tiny exposed synthetic database
major_issues.evidence: GridDB has 8 tables and 98 rows; its 180 evaluation questions were previously exposed. Zero of 91 external candidates have completed human review, and external results are noncanonical diagnostics.
major_issues.required_action: Fully disclose GridDB construction/size/templates and complete meaningful human external validation, preferably a new sealed set; otherwise narrow the title and applied claims to a controlled synthetic case study.
major_issues.verification: Data table contains comparable counts and provenance; external quantitative claims have completed dual review/adjudication and a frozen no-drop run.

major_issues.title: McNemar inference ignores template-cluster dependence
major_issues.evidence: Question-level exact McNemar treats 180 pairs as independent although the analysis declares 70 dependent template clusters; Holm does not repair this dependence.
major_issues.required_action: Use cluster-aware inference or demote McNemar to descriptive sensitivity; define each Holm family explicitly.
major_issues.verification: All inferential decisions use the registered cluster unit and no mixed result is promoted through an independence-violating test.

major_issues.title: DKASQL positioning and baseline adequacy are insufficient
major_issues.evidence: DKASQL is acknowledged as the direct same-journal predecessor but receives no systematic comparison; no reproduced domain or standard text-to-SQL baseline is reported.
major_issues.required_action: Add a technical comparator table, explain numerical comparability, add a standard direct baseline where feasible, and frame novelty as methodological unless superiority is demonstrated.
major_issues.verification: Novelty and baseline claims are traceable to a complete same-journal comparison rather than first-in-domain wording.

major_issues.title: Methods are not self-contained enough to reproduce interventions
major_issues.evidence: Exact selection/hint/value rules, common shape scoring, prompt-length manipulation, software versions and hardware are absent. Full/no-hint context is 631 words; compact/no-hint mean is 150.3 words.
major_issues.required_action: Add algorithms, prompt examples, factor-invariance and length tables, exact scoring contract, environment/hardware, commands, artifact identifiers and statistical citations.
major_issues.verification: An independent reader can reconstruct every prompt and outcome from the paper and supplement.

major_issues.title: Architecture figures depict unevaluated/inaccurate elements and are illegible at page scale
major_issues.evidence: Figure 1 shows a repair pass absent from the formal factorial execution; Figure 3 says models by repetitions despite one generation per prompt; internal text is unreadable in the 18-page PDF.
major_issues.required_action: Remove or mark future components, correct labels, simplify diagrams, enlarge text, and complete manual page-scale QA.
major_issues.verification: All diagram text is readable at 100% page view and every depicted executed stage maps to Methods and artifacts.

major_issues.title: Submission declarations and public artifact access are incomplete
major_issues.evidence: Author, affiliation, CRediT, funding, conflict, acknowledgments, AI-use, public DOI/URL and confirmations remain placeholders; GridDB redistribution permission is unresolved.
major_issues.required_action: Complete all human-author fields, license review and permanent repository deposit without fabricating metadata.
major_issues.verification: No W10_FRONT_MATTER marker remains and the Data Availability Statement resolves each artifact/license boundary.

minor_issues.title: Granite compact-shape Holm p-value is miscopied
minor_issues.required_action: Correct from the canonical artifact after revising the inferential framework.

minor_issues.title: Dichotomous statistical wording is too strong
minor_issues.evidence: The paper uses nonzero modifier and reject equality wording.
minor_issues.required_action: State that intervals exclude/cross zero and avoid treating non-rejection as equality.

minor_issues.title: Dataset table mixes numeric and textual values
minor_issues.evidence: GridDB Tables/Rows cells contain maintenance schema/local.
minor_issues.required_action: Use 8 tables and 98 rows and add comparable provenance/review/license fields.

minor_issues.title: Title plural exceeds the canonical database evidence
minor_issues.evidence: Canonical accuracy uses one synthetic maintenance database; external databases are pilots and not maintenance benchmarks.
minor_issues.required_action: Use singular database or controlled factorial study wording, with no operational inference.

minor_issues.title: Reference audit is stale relative to final manuscript
minor_issues.evidence: Audit describes Tang et al. as uncited reserve, but the assembled manuscript cites it.
minor_issues.required_action: Synchronize the audit and add bootstrap/McNemar/Holm references.

minor_issues.title: Visual QA records automated pass while manual review is pending
minor_issues.evidence: visual_qa.json and VISUAL_QA.md retain manual_visual_review pending.
minor_issues.required_action: Record real page-scale review and remediation before final release.
